name: WDUi Framework SDK
changes_cs: WDUi Framework SDK 0.1.2: live-resize performance fix pro Direct2D/Auto backend. Direct2D render target se pri zmene velikosti jen resizeuje a WDUi behem ziveho resize/move docasne omezi drahe materialove/spatial efekty. Balik zustava proprietarni binarni x64 SDK s hlavickami, wdui.lib, default skiny/fonty, binarnim demem a otevrenou ukazkou pouziti bez zdrojovych cpp souboru knihovny.
changes_en: WDUi Framework SDK 0.1.2: live-resize performance fix for the Direct2D/Auto backend. Direct2D render targets are resized instead of recreated, and WDUi temporarily limits expensive material/spatial effects during live resize/move. The package remains a proprietary binary x64 SDK with headers, wdui.lib, default skins/fonts, binary demo, and an open usage example without library cpp sources.
